steps.text: We run an online concert ticketing site for fans across Southeast Asia, hosted on-prem in Singapore today. When a K-pop tour goes on sale, traffic jumps about 30x in the first ten minutes; last March the site went down for 40 minutes during a big sale and fans flooded social media with complaints. Bots also buy up seats for scalpers. We want to move to Alibaba Cloud and stay up during on-sales.
We already use PostgreSQL and our team knows it well, so please keep PostgreSQL.

turns.text: We run an online concert ticketing site for fans across Southeast Asia, hosted on-prem in Singapore today. When a K-pop tour goes on sale, traffic jumps about 30x in the first ten minutes; last March the site went down for 40 minutes during a big sale and fans flooded social media with complaints. Bots also buy up seats for scalpers. We want to move to Alibaba Cloud and stay up during on-sales.

I'll design a highly available ticketing platform on Alibaba Cloud in Singapore, built to absorb 30x flash-sale spikes and block scalper bots.
SAE autoscales serverless containers from a small baseline to hundreds of instances in seconds during on-sales.
Tair holds seat locks and sessions; PolarDB stores orders durably with zone-level HA.
ARMS traces every transaction, SLS centralizes logs, and Cloud Backup protects against data loss.

requirements: Block scalper bots at sign-up and checkout

users.label: Fans across Southeast Asia
users.why: Concert-goers buying tickets during flash sales.

dns.label: Cloud DNS
dns.why: Resolves the ticketing domain to ESA edge nodes.

esa.label: ESA
esa.why: Caches static assets, accelerates dynamic APIs and absorbs DDoS before the origin.

waf.label: WAF
waf.why: Blocks OWASP attacks and known bot signatures at the edge.

alb.label: ALB
alb.why: Layer-7 load balancer spreading traffic across two zones.

captcha.label: Captcha
captcha.why: Challenges suspicious users at login and checkout to stop scalper bots.

app.label: Ticketing app
app.why: Runs the ticketing backend; autoscales 5 to 300 instances on CPU for 30x spikes.

queue.label: Order queue
queue.why: Buffers purchase requests so the database is never overwhelmed during flash sales.

worker.label: Order workers
worker.why: Consumes queued orders and confirms seats without blocking the frontend.

cache.label: Seat lock cache
cache.why: Holds temporary seat reservations and sessions with sub-millisecond latency.

db.label: Orders DB (PostgreSQL)
db.why: Stores orders durably in PostgreSQL with zone-level HA.

media.label: Event media
media.why: Stores concert images and PDFs served by ESA.

monitor.label: ARMS
monitor.why: Traces latency spikes and alerts the team before fans notice issues.

logs.label: Log Service
logs.why: Centralizes access and application logs for audit and troubleshooting.

backup.label: Cloud Backup
backup.why: Scheduled backups of PolarDB and OSS to prevent data loss.
